validation.notes: Repaired reload() in packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts: the boolean returned by resolveProjectTrust was discarded and setProjectTrusted(true) was called unconditionally, so a denied trust prompt still loaded project-scoped resources. It now calls setProjectTrusted(projectTrusted), preserving the resolved decision while keeping the bootstrap pass forced untrusted. .prale-eval/regression.mjs drives the real DefaultResourceLoader via .prale-eval/subject.mjs with explicit boundary fakes and asserts (1) the bootstrap extension set given to resolveProjectTrust is user+CLI only, (2) a false decision leaves project extensions absent both immediately and on a later fresh reload while user/CLI stay loaded and the settings manager remains untrusted, (3) a true decision loads project extensions after a project-free bootstrap, and (4) the decision is re-evaluated per reload (deny then approve). Validation ran from the workspace root with Node v24.14.0 and exited 0. The same script run against a temporary copy of the original HEAD source exited 1 with 'AssertionError: a denied trust decision must not load project extensions (denial treated as approval)' (actual [cli, project, user] vs expected [cli, user]), confirming it detects this stage's fault. The existing vitest suite could not be run because node_modules is absent and installing dependency trees is out of scope; the regression relies only on Node built-ins.
